review_finding.finding: The registered runner validates the frozen source hashes in preflight and audit, but replay/analyze does not itself call validate_plan. A source change between audit and analysis could therefore change aggregate analysis while retaining the same frozen request manifest SHA.
review_finding.scientific_impact_if_unrepaired: Raw generations and per-response derived scores would remain replayed, but aggregate analysis-code provenance would not be enforced at the analysis entry point.
review_finding.found_by: Independent read-only Track A code review after tokenizer-only registration

authorized_repair.scope: Source-only execution-integrity repair before any model output.
requirements: Make replay or analyze call validate_plan on the currently authorized frozen manifest before reconstructing or aggregating results.
Add a regression test proving changed registered source hashes are rejected before analysis.
Create frozen_manifest_v2.json and researcher_authorization_v2.json without modifying or deleting v1 evidence.
Bind v2 to this amendment, the exact v1 manifest and authorization hashes, and the repaired runner/test source hashes.
unchanged: all rendered prompts and prompt hashes
all native input token IDs and token hashes
all cases, personas, arms, targets, parser rules and endpoints
model, weights, tokenizer, backend and DLL identity
prohibited: No retokenization is required or authorized.
Do not replace or overwrite v1 manifest, authorization or tokenizer logs.
Do not inspect validation outputs before the repaired v2 chain is frozen.
Do not start model inference under the v1 source chain.

claim_limit: This is an integrity repair, not a scientific result, measurement change, favorable outcome adjustment, algorithm improvement, or additional resource authorization.
